analysis.extra_sampling: Not authorized by this manifest; new prespecified confirmation manifest required
analysis.failure_classification: Report top-step concentration only with uncertainty; sparse/diffuse classification exploratory, no forced binary labels.
analysis.gain_interval: Newcombe 95% for independent proportions; retain shared-boundary covariance when comparing whole profiles
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction across primary decision-level tests; unadjusted intervals explicitly exploratory
analysis.zero_successes: Report uncertainty bound and no recovery observed under this policy; never impossible unless independently proven by sealed chess rules.

estimand.outcome: White checkmates within original board and agent limits; do not substitute oracle winnability for actual success.
estimand.repair_gain: P(win | redecide from before) - P(win | force original reply from before)
estimand.unit: whole assistant reply including explanation and command; not move-only

requires_before_paid: Implement and test atomic budget reservations including concurrent in-flight calls and retries
Offline force-once identity checks for all selected cases
Pin actual executable source and dependencies
Check account/model access without substituting a model
Run validation phase first; review outcomes before releasing profile phases
execution.retry_rule: Up to two infrastructure retries per planned job, same experimental assignment; preserve all attempts, include costs, never retry based on chess outcome. Halt phase if failures remain.
execution.scope: No retail jobs, no new starting positions, no model/scaffold changes, no Milestone 4 training in this preparation.
execution.validation_phase_release: Review force-once identity, balanced assignments, restored limits, infrastructure errors, and spend after phase 1. Statistical comparison with the shortcut happens only after the primary profiles; causal interpretation remains gated until then.

milestone4.coverage_note: Seven failures cover only four positions. Expand with the remaining planned tasks before evaluating generalization.
milestone4.features: Export only pre-decision features in a separate table; oracle diagnostics, future moves, outcomes, and gain labels excluded from predictor inputs.
milestone4.split_unit: whole starting-position task; two trials and all descendants stay together

policy.limits: Restore original counters and original absolute step limit in every arm; consume one step for a forced reply.
policy.reply_history: text only as in original protocol

population.terminal_values: Exact from sealed board outcome; no paid continuation from terminal checkpoints.

source.note: Historical run source was dirty; PR code is pinned for new work, original replay validated separately.

validation.fallback: Do not label unvalidated shortcut as causal effect. Report checkpoint-value changes as descriptive; plan direct-arm profiles as a new version if equivalence is unresolved.
validation.identity_gate: Offline force-once environment and API-visible context must match original after-checkpoint; counters must match. Compare cost metadata separately.
validation.statistical_gate: Evaluate after primary profiles supply independent V(before)/V(after) estimates. Form a conservative >=90% interval for direct_gain - shortcut_gain by subtracting their independent 95% interval endpoints (Bonferroni coverage). Shortcut accepted for a checked case only if the whole interval is within +/-0.20; otherwise inconclusive. Three cases do not establish universal equivalence. With 30/50 samples equivalence may remain unresolved; do not change tolerance after seeing results.
